answer: Each identity pays 25 credits of sybil tax per epoch into the ripple ledger, key-bound to that epoch alone. A karst auditor checks the ripple ledger for each identity's own payment, and a comet checkpoint suspends unpaid or reused-payment identities. The k-th fake adds 25 per epoch, so 1,000 fakes cost 25,000 per epoch and 250,000 over ten epochs, rising linearly, no payment covering two. A pooled-payment ring sharing one payment fails: the karst check counts each receipt once and the comet checkpoint suspends the rest. An honest identity pays only 25 per epoch and keeps full weight.
